recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The source already satisfies the seed request; future work should only revisit this if the CapabilityStatement contentReference model changes.
issue_request: FHIR-13104 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 conformance and requested a 0..1 markdown documentation element on CapabilityStatement.rest.operation for describing special operation behavior without changing the referenced OperationDefinition.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-13104. The historical application path is the same family as FHIR-13106: commit 7360889bc386940c5ef3305ee7fafce957a08725 made CapabilityStatement.rest.operation reuse CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation, and commit 9e5e6b6148200ba40e05540d1e6f4aefcca3f6e5 added CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation.documentation with the requested behavior text.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. The current XML defines CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation.documentation as 0..1 markdown and defines CapabilityStatement.rest.operation as a contentReference to CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation. The already-published FHIR-13106 audit on the combined branch documents the related resource-operation split. A Zulip implementer thread later used CapabilityStatement.rest.operation.documentation as the expected place for non-computable operation expectations, and no Confluence or later core Jira evidence was found that conflicts with this model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding an explicit duplicate CapabilityStatement.rest.operation.documentation element would be incorrect for the current contentReference representation because the shared backbone already carries the documentation child.
